title: India’s mass voter purge is hollowing out democracy

ai.summary: Protesters demanded the resignation of India's chief election commissioner over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter purge, which removed over 130 million names from electoral rolls, disproportionately affecting marginalized communities.

facts.quote: removal of more than 130 million names from India’s electoral rolls
The exercise has disproportionately affected Muslims, women, migrants and other marginalised communities

ai.background_note: The SIR voter purge has led to significant disenfranchisement among marginalized groups, with the BJP gaining electoral advantage in states like Bihar and West Bengal after the removal of millions of voters.
